status: development-only calibration plan, frozen before any fitted error was inspected

inputs.windows: the 442 primary windows produced by compare.py under benchmark-plan.json (20 m, confidence 1, caliper within 1 inch); no new windows are selected for this calibration
inputs.holdout: never opened; the 24 holdout wells are scored once, later, with the single adopted set

physics: the actual rockVelocity/porosity functions bundled from src/basin.ts; coefficients are overridden in memory, not reimplemented
history_semantics: present burial equals maximum burial; brine; isotropic; observed classes mapped to model endmembers f=0 shale, f=1 sandstone; the same 1 m slowness quadrature per 20 m bin as model-profiles.mjs

cement_from.meaning: burial where the cementation blend starts, m

cement_width.meaning: cementation blend width, m; cementTo = cement_from + cement_width

pressure_top.meaning: top of the prescribed overpressure profile, m; the untuned reference uses none

objective: equal-parent-weighted mean squared error of predicted minus observed window velocity, m^2/s^2; every parameter starts at its default; Nelder-Mead in normalized bounds with two restarts
cross_validation: leave-one-parent-well-out: each parent's windows are predicted by coefficients fitted on all other parents, from the default start; no warm start from the full fit
report_metrics: bias, MAE and root mean per-parent MSE with equal parent weight, as in benchmark-plan.json; by facies and by 1 km depth band
selection_rule: adopt the set with the lowest leave-one-parent-out MAE; ties within 5 m/s favor fewer parameters; adopt nothing if the paired bootstrap interval of (adopted-set CV MAE minus untuned MAE) includes zero
adoption: the adopted set's full-development fit is written to the source coefficients; its in-sample score is reported as in-sample, and the LOO score is the headline
not_done_here: no holdout scoring, no window re-selection, no change to quality screens, no change to mineral moduli or fluid properties, no per-well parameters
